meta.title: Iran Update Special Report: US and Israeli Strikes, February 28, 2026

key_takeaways: The United States and Israel have launched a strike campaign into Iran in order to topple the Islamic Republic, among other objectives.

events.summary: Iran struck US bases in six regional states in retaliation.
events.evidence_quote: Iran has attacked US bases in Bahrain, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait, Jordan, and Saudi Arabia.

events.summary: Israel reportedly killed senior Iranian security officials.
events.evidence_quote: Israeli officials assess that the IDF killed Defense Council Secretary Ali Shamkhani

analyst_caveats: Some of the information that is available in the open-source will be contradictory or inaccurate.
